youtube.baslik: Why does testing sixteen kilohertz need special earphones? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: At extended high frequencies, the wavelength drops to a few centimeters and standing waves form in the ear canal; even a small shift of the earphone can clearly change the sound pressure reaching the eardrum. So specially designed circumaural earphones are mostly used. When you see a change, reposition the earphone and measure those frequencies again.
